## Getting set up

You should already have the CSB book's GitHub repository with exercise files in
your personal dir within `/fs/ess/PAS2880` from Thursday's class.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
#### Don't have these files? _(Click to expand)_

1. Go to your personal dir within `/fs/ess/PAS2880`:

```bash
cd `/fs/ess/PAS2880/users/$USER
```

2. Download ("clone") the GitHub repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/CSB-book/CSB.git
```
:::

<hr style="height:1pt; visibility:hidden;" />

## Exercise 1: Navigation in the Unix shell

**(a)** Go to `/fs/ess/PAS2880/users/$USER`

**(b)** Navigate to the `sandbox` directory within the `CSB/unix` directory.  

**(c)** Use a *relative* path to go to the `data` directory within the `python` directory.  

**(d)** Use an *absolute* path to go to the `sandbox` directory within `CSB/python`.  

<br>

## Solutions

### Exercise 1

<details><summary>Solution</summary>

**(a)** ~~Go to your home directory.~~ Go to `/fs/ess/PAS2880/users/$USER`.

```sh
cd /fs/ess/PAS2880/users/$USER # To home would have been: "cd ∼"
```

**(b)** Navigate to the `sandbox` directory within the `CSB/unix` directory.

```sh
cd CSB/unix/sandbox
```

**(c)** Use a *relative* path to go to the `data` directory within the `python`
directory.

```sh
cd ../../python/data
```

**(d)** Use an *absolute* path to go to the `sandbox` directory within `python`.

```sh
cd /fs/ess/PAS2880/users/$USER/CSB/python/sandbox
```

</details>
